annotations.title: RSS, Atom and JSON Feed to JSON

description: Read news feeds or blogs as clean JSON: accepts feed URLs or plain site URLs (finds the feed via <link rel=alternate>), normalises RSS 0.9x/2.0, RDF, Atom and JSON Feed to one item schema (title, url, publishedAt, author, categories, summary), up to 100 items per feed. Free for 1 feed; up to 5 feeds per call cost $0.003 USDC. Paid calls made without a payment return isError with the x402 v2 PaymentRequired object (amount in USDC atomic units, network, payTo, HTTP endpoint); retry with the signed PaymentPayload in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid input and calls where every item fails are never charged. Fetches follow robots.txt, use the User-Agent AdamHaleTools/1.0 and refuse private or internal addresses.

items.description: A public http(s) URL or bare domain (bare domain = its https:// homepage). No IP addresses, internal names or ports other than 80/443.

x402_payment.description: Optional, paid tier only: a signed x402 v2 PaymentPayload, base64 (the value an HTTP client sends as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Prefer params._meta["x402/payment"]. Never a private key or seed phrase.
